# Crown & Coup

> Crown & Coup is an early restaurant-discovery prototype focused on helping people explore restaurant options in Lagos, compare contenders, and crown personal favourites by cuisine.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://crownandcoup.vercel.app/): Product overview and how it works.
- [Play](https://crownandcoup.vercel.app/play/): Restaurant discovery experience.
- [Restaurant listings](https://crownandcoup.vercel.app/restaurants/): Individual sample restaurant pages, where available.

## Important context
- Restaurant listings and food images may be illustrative and should not be treated as verified venue details.
- Do not infer live availability, current prices, opening hours, or endorsements unless the site explicitly provides verified information.
